[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#rag-service-helper-scripts]

# RAG Service Helper Scripts

This directory contains helper scripts for RAG Service API setup, development, and maintenance. These scripts streamline AI-powered document search and retrieval API development, configuration management, and deployment processes.
page_texts.3:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#core-components]

### Core Components

```text
_helpers/
├── scripts/                     # Utility scripts directory (see scripts/README.md)
├── setup.py                     # Environment setup and initialization
├── build.py                     # Build orchestration script
├── run.py                       # Development server script
├── verify.py                    # Configuration and setup verification
└── README.md                    # This documentation
```
page_texts.4:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#main-helper-scripts-required]

### Main Helper Scripts (Required)

| Script | Purpose | Usage |
|--------|---------|-------|
| `setup.py` | Environment setup, dependency installation, configuration generation, and activation guidance | `python setup.py` |
| `verify.py` | Code quality verification, testing, and configuration validation | `python verify.py` |
| `build.py` | Build orchestration for setup, verify, build, and serve | `python build.py` |
| `run.py` | Development server for RAG Service API | `python run.py` |
page_texts.5:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#scripts-directory-utilities]

### Scripts Directory (Utilities)

The `scripts/` subdirectory contains 5 utility scripts with the following usage patterns:

- **Referenced Scripts** 🔗: `start-activated-shell.py` (called by setup.py), `version_utils.py` (imported by build.py)
- **Standalone Alternatives** ⭐: `build_docker.py`, `check_code_quality.py`, `check_tests.py` (modular alternatives to integrated functionality)

See `scripts/README.md` for detailed documentation of each utility script. All utility scripts are Python-based for cross-platform compatibility (Windows, Mac, Linux).
page_texts.7:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#initial-setup]

### Initial Setup

```bash
# Set up RAG Service API environment (works on Windows, Mac, Linux)
python _helpers/setup.py

# With dependency upgrades
python _helpers/setup.py --upgrade

# Then activate the environment (follow platform-specific instructions from setup.py)
# Or use the convenience script:
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py

# This will:
# - Verify prerequisites (Python 3.12+, Poetry, Git)
# - Set up project structure
# - Create .env file from template
# - Install Poetry dependencies including AI components (LangChain, OpenAI)
# - Initialize RAG service configuration
# - Provide cross-platform activation guidance
# - Create convenience scripts (start-activated-shell.py)
```
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#running-rag-service-api]

### Running RAG Service API

```bash
# Build and serve RAG Service API
python _helpers/build.py              # Full build pipeline (setup → verify → build → serve)
python _helpers/run.py                # Start development server only

# Manual steps
python _helpers/setup.py              # Initial setup
python _helpers/verify.py             # Verify configuration
uvicorn src.main:app --reload         # Serve directly
```
page_texts.9:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#cross-platform-environment-management]

### Cross-Platform Environment Management

```bash
# Environment validation and activation guidance
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Start activated shell

# This works identically on Windows, Mac, and Linux
# Cross-platform activation guidance integrated into setup.py
```

page_texts.11:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#integrated-tools]

### Integrated Tools

- **Black**: Code formatting and style consistency
- **Ruff**: Fast Python linter with extensive rule coverage
- **isort**: Import statement organization and sorting
- **Bandit**: Security vulnerability and best practices scanning
- **Pytest**: Unit testing with coverage reporting (90% minimum coverage)
page_texts.12:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#coverage-requirements]

### Coverage Requirements

- Minimum test coverage: 90%
- All new code must include comprehensive tests
- Coverage reports generated in `.tmp/coverage-report/`
- Focus on AI/RAG functionality testing with proper mocking
page_texts.14:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#test-structure]

### Test Structure

Tests follow a 1:1 mapping with source code:

- `src/main.py` → `tests/test_main.py`
- `src/rag/search_engine.py` → `tests/rag/test_search_engine.py`
- `src/api/endpoints.py` → `tests/api/test_endpoints.py`
page_texts.15:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#running-tests]

### Running Tests

```bash
# Run all tests with coverage
python _helpers/verify.py --tests-only

# Run specific test file
poetry run pytest tests/test_main.py -v

# Run with detailed coverage report
poetry run pytest --cov=src tests/ --cov-report=html:.tmp/coverage-report/
```
page_texts.16:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#building-docker-images]

## Building Docker Images

The build script supports both interactive and command-line usage for Docker image creation:
page_texts.17:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#interactive-mode-recommended]

### Interactive Mode (Recommended)

```bash
python _helpers/build.py
```

The script will prompt you to choose:

1. **registry** (default) - Use ECR registry URL for cloud deployment
2. **dev** - Use development environment configuration
3. **prod** - Use production environment configuration

Press Enter to use the default (registry) option. For local development, you can press Enter again to skip the registry URL and build locally.
page_texts.18:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#command-line-mode]

### Command-Line Mode

```bash
# Development environment
python _helpers/build.py --docker-env=dev

# Production environment with push to ECR
python _helpers/build.py --docker-env=prod

# Custom registry
python _helpers/build.py --registry=my-registry.com/repo

# Local build only (no push)
python _helpers/build.py --registry=my-registry.com/repo --skip-push
```
page_texts.19:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#build-options]

### Build Options

- `--docker-env` - Use environment config (dev/prod)
- `--registry` - Specify ECR registry URL
- `--repository` - Override repository name
- `--tag` - Custom image tag
- `--no-cache` - Build without Docker cache
- `--skip-push` - Build only, don't push to registry
- `--cleanup` - Remove local images after push
page_texts.20:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#cross-platform-compatibility]

## Cross-Platform Compatibility

All scripts are Python-based and work identically on:

- ✅ **Windows** (PowerShell, Command Prompt)
- ✅ **Mac** (Terminal, bash, zsh)
- ✅ **Linux** (bash, zsh, other shells)

No platform-specific scripts (.bat, .ps1, .sh) are used. All path handling and platform detection is done in Python using `os.name`, `platform.system()`, and `pathlib.Path`.
page_texts.21:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#ai-development-integration]

## AI Development Integration

This helper system is designed to work with AI development tools and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows:

- Scripts provide clear error messages and guidance for AI development
- Comprehensive logging for debugging AI functionality
- Standardized interfaces for RAG service development
- Integration with VS Code and GitHub Copilot workflows
- Support for AI model mocking during development
page_texts.22:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#common-workflows]

### Common Workflows

**New RAG Service Development**:

```bash
python _helpers/setup.py                          # Setup environment with AI dependencies
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Activate environment
python _helpers/verify.py                         # Verify configuration
```

**Environment Troubleshooting**:

```bash
python _helpers/setup.py                          # Setup environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Activate environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Start activated shell
```

**Production Preparation**:

```bash
python _helpers/setup.py                          # Setup environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Activate environment
python _helpers/verify.py                         # Full verification
python _helpers/build.py                          # Build and test service
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=prod --push  # Containerized build
```
page_texts.23:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#airag-features]

### AI/RAG Features

- **Document Processing**: Support for PDF, text, and markdown document ingestion
- **Vector Search**: Semantic search using embeddings with proper testing
- **AI Integration**: Integration with LangChain and OpenAI models
- **Mock Support**: Development mode with AI mocking for testing
- **API Endpoints**: FastAPI-based REST API for document search and retrieval
page_texts.24:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/_helpers/README.md#script-organization]

### Script Organization

- **Main Scripts**: 4 core scripts in `_helpers/` root (setup, verify, build, run)
- **Utility Scripts**: 5 essential scripts in `scripts/` subdirectory
- **Cross-Platform**: Pure Python, no shell scripts
- **Consistent Interface**: All scripts support `--help`
- **AI-Ready**: All scripts support AI development workflows and dependencies
